subject: [PATCH v1 1/3] mm: memcontrol: factor reclaim logic out of try_charge_memcg()

reviews.author: Rik van Riel
reviews.summary: The reviewer appreciated the cleanup effort and provided a formal Reviewed-by tag, indicating that they have reviewed the code and it meets their standards.

2026-10-03.patch_summary: This patch refactors the reclaim logic in try_charge_memcg() into helper functions, allowing for easier reuse and maintenance of this code. The changes include moving the memcg_charge_may_reclaim() function to check if spinning is allowed, and extracting the memcg_charge_reclaim() function to handle memory events and reclaiming pages.
